title: Circuit with depth, width, and tail size bounds
statement: A Boolean function $f$ on $n$ coordinates has a depth-$d$ circuit of width at most $w$ and tail size at most $s'$ if there is a depth circuit $C$ computing $f$ such that its depth is exactly $d$, its width is at most $w$, and the number of internal nodes in its tail, plus one, is at most $s'$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function f on n coordinates
natural numbers d, w, and s'
circuit width is at most w
tail internal-node count plus one is at most s'
